coverage.title: GOOGLE 🔥: Besides preparation for Gemini 4 release on Antigravity, Google is also prototyping its own voice agent…

summary: GOOGLE 🔥: Besides preparation for Gemini 4 release on Antigravity, Google is also prototyping its own voice agent, internally called "Concierge". Yet, it looks like a very early version, and it is hard to say if it will ever see the light of day in its current form. https://t.co/wNNl42YvdE
